name: Hard tests, run by Epoch AI
what_it_measures: Share of questions each model gets right on benchmarks Epoch runs itself, with a standard error.
licence_note: Epoch-run results only. Benchmark questions and answers belong to their creators; only scores are used.
citation: Epoch AI, 'Capabilities & Benchmarking'. Published online at epoch.ai. Retrieved from https://epoch.ai/benchmarks

coverage.summary: Only models Epoch chooses to run through an API: mostly US frontier labs plus the major Chinese labs. Rows: GPQA Diamond 311, FrontierMath, tiers 1-3 108, SWE-bench Verified 35. Models without an API, and labs that don't give access, are missing.
coverage.counted: Most rows: OpenAI 138, Alibaba 72, Anthropic 69, Google DeepMind 48, DeepSeek 20, Mistral AI 19, Z.ai (Zhipu AI) 18, xAI 14.
coverage.not_counted: Models with no public API; results other projects publish (those files keep their own licences and are not copied).

benchmarks.name: FrontierMath, tiers 1-3
